 2027–28 FAFSA Form Now Available
 The 2027–28 Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA ® ) form is now available. Students can complete the form to apply for financial aid for attending college or career/trade school between July 1, 2027, and June 30, 2028.
 If your students successfully submitted their FAFSA form for the 2027–28 academic year during the early testing period, they don't need to resubmit it.
 Most FAFSA forms are processed immediately. Some can take one to three days. Once a student's form is processed, they can review their FAFSA Submission Summary. Their FAFSA information will also be sent to their selected schools.
 Resources for Reference and Outreach
 Use these resources to prepare to help students with the 2027–28 FAFSA form. 
 2027–28 FAFSA ® Prototype — Prototype providing counselors
 and mentors with a partial preview of the online 2027–28
 FAFSA form and common applicant scenarios.
 2027–28 FAFSA ® Preview Presentation — Presentation providing screenshots of the 2027–28 FAFSA form.
 "FAFSA ® Updates" — Financial Aid Toolkit page providing
 counselors and mentors with the latest forms and information
 associated with the FAFSA process.
 You can also browse our full selection of 2027–28 resources .
